title: TrackSource
description: Immutable original track evidence and provenance associated with one Activity. TrackSource is source-agnostic and is not limited to filesystem files.

activity.description: Stable project-local Activity identity to which this source evidence belongs.

origin.description: Source namespace/origin and source-native provenance. These values never become global Activity identity by themselves.

representation.description: Description of the durable source evidence representation. This is intentionally not file-only.

namespace.description: Namespaced source/origin identifier such as a local import namespace or provider namespace. No fixed provider enum is imposed by the portable core.

native_id.description: Optional source-native identifier, meaningful only within namespace.

locator.description: Optional provenance locator or source reference. A remote URL by itself does not prove durable acquisition.

media_type.description: Media/representation type of the preserved source evidence, for example application/gpx+xml, application/json, or a FIT media type.

original_name.description: Optional original display/file name. It is provenance only and is not identity.

content_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 content identity when byte/content hashing is available. Runtime idempotency policy remains a later milestone concern.
